title.en: An Act Providing For the Separation of the Barangay Oringao Extension High School Located in the Municipality of Kabankalan, Province of Negros Occidental, From the Binicuil High School and To Be Known As Florentino Galang, Sr. National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

text.en: The Barangay Oringao Extension Class located in the Municipality of Kabankalan, Negros Occidental, is hereby separated from the Binicuil High School and shall henceforth be known as the Florentino Galang, Sr. National High School.
The Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.

The amount necessary for the implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Binicuil National High School-Barangay Oringao Extension High School. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the operation and maintenance of the Florentino Galang, Sr. National High School shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
